title: Histogram
text: Histogram of input or sequence of inputs, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Reset port} sets Reset event Non-zero; {Lower limit of histogram} sets the lower boundary of lowest-valued, {Upper limit of histogram} sets the upper boundary of highest-valued bin, {Number of bins} sets the number of histogram bins, {Find the histogram over} sets the compute histogram over each column or entire input Each, {Normalized} sets the normalize output, {Running histogram} sets the track frequency distribution over time, {Rounding mode} sets the method of rounding, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Product output}, {Accumulator} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Data input vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Histogram output vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Lower limit of histogram
params.values: Lower boundary of lowest-valued bin scalar

params.name: Upper limit of histogram
params.values: Upper boundary of highest-valued bin scalar

params.name: Number of bins
params.values: Number of histogram bins positive integer

params.name: Find the histogram over
params.values: Compute histogram over each column or entire input Each column (default) | Entire input

params.name: Running histogram
params.values: Track frequency distribution over time off (default) | on

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Reset event Non-zero sample (default) | None | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Method of rounding operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
